title: Bring your Live Activity to Apple Watch
description: Bring Live Activities into the Smart Stack on Apple Watch with iOS 18 and watchOS 11. We’ll cover how Live Activities are presented on Apple Watch, as well as how you can enhance their presentation for the Smart Stack. We’ll also explore additional considerations to ensure Live Activities on Apple Watch always present up-to-date information.

resources.description: Use ActivityKit to receive push tokens and to remotely start, update, and end your Live Activity with ActivityKit notifications.
